answer: One defense is quadratic stake per identity. Honest agents weave a trellis of mutual vouches, each vouch a public mirror of on-chain history that a fake peer cannot fabricate. An attacker wanting k Sybil nodes must lock k-squared collateral and earn k independent vouches, so forging twenty peers costs about four hundred times one honest bond. We prune the graph like an orchard, cutting any branch with no independent root, culling the attacker's isolated cluster and slashing its stake.
